response.description:
Azure Event Grid offers a variety of features in
Public Preview – intended to help you better manage large-scale, distributed
systems with improved interoperability and control.  Public Preview Features:  
 Cross-Tenant
     Webhook Delivery: Enables secure cross-tenant delivery using managed
     identity in Event Grid namespaces.  
 Network Security Perimeter:
     Defines access boundaries with inbound and outbound communication rules
     for enhanced security.  
 Managed
     Identity for Webhooks: Automates secure authentication between Event
     Grid and webhook endpoints.  
 MQTT OAuth
     2.0 Authentication: Uses JWTs from OIDC-compliant providers for secure
     client access.  
 MQTT
     Custom Webhook Authentication: Dynamically authorizes clients via
     external webhooks or Azure Functions.  
 MQTT
     Assigned Client Identifiers: Assigns static client IDs for better
     session consistency and traceability.
response.title: Public Preview: Azure Event Grid provides new capabilities for smarter, more secure event-driven architectures
